'''Scorcher505 Yoda's X-wings''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Scorcher505]]
* '''Published:''' 10 November 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Dagobah: Bog Clearing|Dagobah-L-dagobahbogclearing.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Dagobah: Bog Clearing
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 Dagobah Bog Clearing Scorcher505 LS YodasXwi.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is a Dagobah force drain/ space power deck. Review for me please and give me advice.

== Strategy ==

The objective of this deck is to get Yoda on Dagobah so I can deploy tibanna gas miners there to add to force drains in clouds. With Kebyc on Dagobah, all force lost from drains in clouds has to come from reserve deck. With Dagobah as my starting location, I can pull out Dagobah sites to add to completeing Jedi test #1, with makes all opponents force drain bouses canceled. If by chance my opponent has alot of space, i can S-Foils X-wing swarm them, with an organized attack. I recently won a tournament with this deck and my other deck "Darth Vader and his amazing friends". Tell me how I can improve the speed of this deck, because it is a little bit slow.
